coverage_limitations: This is a design-coverage ledger, not application implementation or runtime acceptance. Every implementation_status describes dashboard parity, not whether a Python CLI exists.

Static finite sets: four runner parser declaration graphs, three named effective policy config dataclasses, GR00T closed-loop YAML, AssistanceCfg JSON, typed/legacy experiment envelope/builder fields, DCRG config, graph override declarations and documented controller operations.

Dynamic registered environment factories/subcommands and custom policy classes, arbitrary asset/task/relation constructor kwargs, attached variation schemas, custom modality Python classes, joint-map contents and arbitrary Kit extensions are not exhausted. Each needs a separately approved, immutable operator profile/schema extension before submission; arbitrary browser imports/shell/paths remain excluded.

The ledger records symbolic factory/path defaults without executing them. Environment-variable precedence and provider/checkpoint/service availability are not evaluated; no secret files or values were read.

Source hashes bind cited snapshots; existing audit appendix line references are evidence provenance and may need regeneration after source changes. This is not a clean-checkout or global Git-state assertion.
No parser construction/--help, package import, runtime/test invocation, simulator, network, service lifecycle, model call, database read/write or job was performed.
Numerical workbench cumulative wall/call/token/episode/storage/GPU ceilings, approved serving/display profiles and privileged schema provisioning require explicit implementation/live-test approval.
The 29 workflow rules are curated source-backed hazards, not exhaustive Cartesian coverage of all flags/config/plugin combinations.

remaining_audit_gaps.detail: Fields are enumerated but not established as effective controls in the inspected remote path. Verify transitive consumers per approved GR00T profile; do not present served denoising/RNG controls or claim checkpoint selection.

Characterize document-specific dynamic flag registration when graph adapter initially inspects process argv; Boolean false omission and dash/underscore destination collisions need explicit fail-closed handling.

All custom environment subcommands/typed factory fields, arbitrary policy classes, attached asset variation schemas, modality Python, joint maps and Kit extensions are not exhausted. Their exclusion from browser raw-input surface is explicit; newly supported profiles need separate static schema/consumer enumeration and approval.

No actual parser, config instantiation, import availability, provider/policy protocol, camera/backend, GPU cleanup/lease, server attestation, graph transaction/readback or browser receipt verified. Live acceptance and numerical cumulative budgets remain approval-gated.

Runtime path/default factories and environment-dependent defaults remain expressions, not evaluated values. Rank/rebuild summary normalization, settle truncation/threshold behavior, viewport-only camera startup and source-count changes need characterization before closing implementation acceptance.
